# Amrith Shanbhag

> Amrith spent a decade growing communities for consumer startups including Product Hunt. Now he builds his own products.

Amrith (@amrith) is a builder and a community and organic-growth generalist. For roughly ten years he was the first non-technical hire and the community and growth lead across consumer tech, known for organic, zero-spend growth, community building, brand, ASO/SEO, and product-led growth. He thinks of himself as the bridge between the team building a product and the people it is for: getting them to care, and turning them into the product's best marketers. Today he builds his own consumer products, for the love of the game.

## Building now
- [Timebase](https://timebase.me): a calmer way to visualize and plan across time zones; get countdowns to events on your calendar, and plan meetings at a time that works for everyone.
- [Shio](https://shio.sh): a mobile-first terminal built for the agent era.
- [Dhuni](https://dhuni.net): a 24/7 internet radio for Indian classical, Hindustani, Carnatic, instrumental, and vintage music; a quiet listening world for deep focus, by Samooh.
- [Stem](https://stem.md): the place your curiosity is looking for. A social platform for documenting your rabbit holes and niche interests, and exploring others'. Find trails worth following; leave trails worth finding.
- [Medivalent](https://medivalent.com): cross-border medicine equivalence; find the local equivalent of a medicine in another country.
- [Samooh](https://samooh.com): a community for Indian-origin founders building global products.

## Past lives
Feathrd, Product Hunt, Opal, Stoic, Envision, and others.
- [Product Hunt](https://producthunt.com/@amrith): community team to Head of Social; grew the audience from 200K to 400K+ organically.

## Working together
Amrith is happy to talk to founders building in consumer who want help with community, organic growth, ASO/SEO, and product-led growth. No pitch necessary.
